failure_modes.recovery: Read the expense to see its current status.
failure_modes.when: the expense is not in 'draft' (already submitted or resolved)

failure_modes.recovery: Only the expense's creator submits it for approval.
failure_modes.when: the expense belongs to another user (submit is own-expenses-only)

preconditions: id is required. draft → pending; notifies nobody silently — approvers see it in the Team Claims view.

description: Sends your own draft expense into the approval queue — draft only; an already-submitted or resolved expense refuses CONFLICT, and only the expense's own creator may submit it. Nobody is notified automatically — approvers see it appear in the Team Claims view. NEXT: expense_approve or expense_reject (admin/owner).
name: expense_submit
